behavioral_intents: Detect adversaries using PowerShell to register and immediately modify scheduled tasks with elevated privileges, often via MSI installers as a persistence or privilege escalation vector.
Detect attackers using rdrleakdiag.exe with /fullmemdmp flag to dump LSASS process memory for credential extraction (T1003.001 - OS Credential Dumping).

Detect scheduled task engines or system loaders spawning WSH interpreters (cscript/wscript) to execute scripts from user-writable or temporary paths, a common lateral movement and persistence technique.
